   "JPMorgan forecasts a record $2.1tr of US High Grade (HG) gross supply for 2027, a 5% YoY increase, as $2tr+ annual supply becomes the new norm.",
   "Net issuance is projected to rise 13% to a record $1.06tr, though this represents 11.2% of the current market size, which is in line with the long-term average.",
   "Technology and Media sectors are the primary drivers, expected to account for nearly 30% of total HG supply and 50% of market-wide net issuance.",
